stages.title: Inventory the evidence
stages.description: Read the design, harness, methods, draft and result files; preserve originals and record provenance.

stages.title: Derive the numbers once
stages.description: Extract from source data with explicit denominators, units, uncertainty, missingness and cost coverage.

stages.title: Build and inspect data figures
stages.description: Require every expected series, render publication-sized charts and inspect their labels, units and scales.
stages.output: Vector figures, previews and review notes

stages.title: Include the design visuals
stages.description: Choose explanatory panels, preserve attribution and inspect every crop without hiding context or footnotes.
stages.output: Checked design panels and crop record

stages.title: Verify every reference
stages.description: Check metadata against authoritative records and read the cited material for claim support.

stages.title: Write the paper as an argument
stages.description: Tell the story from problem and design through harness, test, results and limitations, with accurate AI disclosure.

stages.title: Compile and inspect all pages
stages.description: Read the build log and inspect the complete paper, title page, figures and tables at useful resolution.

stages.title: Run a clean preflight
stages.description: Build exactly the allowlisted source in a new directory; inspect dependencies, logs, text and fonts.
stages.output: Local portability report and clean-build PDF

stages.title: Package for two purposes
stages.description: Keep the minimal submission archive separate from the review package and full study kit.
stages.output: Explicit source archive and rebuild README

stages.title: Hand off the human decisions
stages.description: Report remaining evidence, author review, release rights, category, licence, endorsement and submission decisions.
